process.branch_max_age_h.description: A branch whose first event is older than this many hours is stale: branch.stale is emitted when a trigger event (process.branch_trigger_types) is appended (D-069 item 11; P-32, events never a clock).

process.branch_trigger_types.description: Event types whose append evaluates branch age on the PR's channel (P-32). integration.advanced names no PR, so it cannot trigger a per-branch check.

process.decisions_register.description: The decision register (ADRs); a row a PR adds or changes must cite its premises (D-066, D-069 item 10).

process.postmortem_check_heading.description: Heading of the section that names the check and the test that prevent the incident's class (D-069 item 9).

process.postmortem_dir.description: Directory of the blameless postmortems (D-069 item 9); one file per incident, named by process.postmortem_name_pattern.

process.postmortem_name_pattern.description: File name of a postmortem: its incident date and a slug (YYYY-MM-DD-slug.md).

process.postmortem_ref_check.description: Label of a `- check: <file>` line under the preventing-check heading: a gate check file that must exist.

process.postmortem_ref_test.description: Label of a `- test: <file>::<name>` line under the preventing-check heading: a test that must exist in that file.

process.postmortem_template.description: The postmortem template inside process.postmortem_dir; it is not itself checked as an incident.
